sources.title: Regnant · Intelligence a nation can own outright
sources.snippet: Regnant is a Sovereign Artificial Intelligence research and infrastructure company, headquartered in Dar es Salaam. Sovereign language models, decision simulation, and sovereign infrastructure, owned down to the weights and the hardware.

sources.title: Products: Regnant
sources.snippet: Self-hosted, AI-powered workflow automation with human-in-the-loop decisions, a visual designer, real-time execution monitoring, and a full audit trail. Zero cloud lock-in, one exposed port, every decision recorded with its justification.
